title: Oath and Veil
author: Astrid Oyelaran
blurb: Marguerite Voss, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
